assets.name: Pepperbox Watchman
assets.notes: Clear aiming head and muzzle bores. Preserve the favourite silhouette; separate the fixed base from the yawing head.

assets.name: Kilnheart Lobber
assets.notes: Compact heavy body and short wide muzzle. Add a clear yaw joint above the planted supports. Variant 1 is the longer-barrel alternate; variant 3 the more ornate alternate.

assets.name: Tuning-Fork Conductor
assets.notes: Strong fork silhouette. Model solid electrode tips instead of the hollow-looking bores. Place the emission origin between the prongs.

assets.name: Resonance Bell
assets.notes: Simple radial bell, brass hoop and amber crown. Keep pulse effects in the game rather than the mesh.

assets.name: Dugout Automaton
assets.notes: Good base and arm. Move the hand nearer the butt knob: the reference still grips near the taper. Keep most of the bat beyond the grip, with a vertical yaw pivot and hit marker at the tip.

assets.name: Bramble Wisp
assets.notes: Broad leaf-like armour gives a distinctive bramble silhouette. Variant 3 is the more mechanical alternate. Use simple hover motion before articulating every thorn.

assets.name: Skipper Moth
assets.notes: Clean wings without the obvious smoke trail of variant 3. Test wing opacity and silhouette at gameplay distance.

assets.name: Bulwark Hermit
assets.notes: Heavy low crab stance and clear supporting legs. Variant 3 is a friendlier alternate; variant 2 has a more helmet-like face. Resolve hidden leg layout before rigging.

assets.name: Ramjet Beetle
assets.notes: Clear ram tusks, forward visor and sturdy grounded stance. Use a simple four-leg articulation contract.

assets.name: Pip the Lantern Keeper
assets.notes: Readable face, chest lantern and weapon. Needs coordinated locomotion and aiming; the biped presentation differs from the current hovering hero.

assets.name: Keepsake Cache
assets.notes: Clean box, readable latch and lid seam. Model the cream top as a solid inset lid.

assets.name: Cinder Puffer
assets.notes: User authorized agent selection. Capped teal top variant1; coral pressure vessel, brass plugs, orange-red glass eye.

events.text: 12 selected concepts. User approved Cinder Puffer variant1. Original assets preserved. Completion requires visual review, correct attack/movement behavior, gameplay integration, tests and uncontended performance comparison.
Sol high asset agents started Keepsake Cache, Pepperbox Watchman and Bramble Wisp. All remaining reference files and pivot briefs prepared.

Original game: all 846 tests passed with no risky tests, unexpected errors or remaining orphans. No new models integrated yet. Baseline performance will be captured when no Blender rendering competes for GPU.

Bramble iteration2 passes geometry contract (11,772 triangles, 7 meshes/materials), but face texture and iris proportions do not match the reference. Returned to generator for correction; not accepted or promoted. Pepperbox iteration1 exposed a texture-buffer issue; generator is repairing it and reducing accessory tessellation.
Reviewed harness iteration 4; contract passed. Copied source and export into game collection. Godot import and runtime review remain pending.

Pepperbox iteration4 accepted and imported: 9,702 triangles, 12 meshes, 8 materials, four 1024px textures. Combat screenshot confirms it appears at game scale with directional head and barrels. Runtime import has no errors; all 846 existing tests pass after loader/motion integration. Full roster behavior and performance remain pending. Plasma generation started.
Reviewed harness iteration 4; contract passed. Copied source and export into game collection. Godot import and runtime review remain pending.

Keepsake Cache iteration4 visually accepted and imported: 12,524 triangles, 11 meshes, 8 materials, four embedded 1024px textures. Gameplay-scale roster capture confirms colours, closed lid and health bar. All 848 tests pass, including new motion rest-pose/reduced-motion checks. Hoverers no longer require legacy legs. Shock generation started with a central radial emission marker. Resource audit passes 14 model records. Performance pending until GPU is uncontended.
Reviewed harness iteration 5; contract passed. Copied source and export into game collection. Godot import and runtime review remain pending.

Kilnheart Lobber iteration5 accepted: 10,102 triangles, 12 meshes, 8 materials, four textures. Distinct short open bore and coral face ring. Feet/base remain fixed while the head yaws. Imported successfully; gameplay review remains pending. Tesla generation started.

checks.Full game tests: 848 pass after Cache integration; final roster pending
